mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders( order_no, member_no, orderer_name, orderer_phone_number, orderer_email, order_status, total_price, created_at, receiver_name, receiver_phone_number, receiver_zip_code, receiver_base_address, receiver_detail_address, message ) VALUES ( seq_orders.NEXTVAL, #{memberNo}, #{ordererName}, #{ordererPhoneNumber}, #{ordererEmail}, 'ORDERED', #{totalPrice}, SYSDATE, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhoneNumber}, #{receiverZipCode}, #{receiverBaseAddress}, #{receiverDetailAddress}, #{message} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE member_no = #{memberNo} ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT o.order_no as orderNo, o.member_no as memberNo, o.orderer_name as ordererName, o.total_price as totalPrice, o.order_status as orderStatus, o.created_at as createdAt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY o.created_at DESC) as rn FROM orders o WHERE member_no = #{memberNo} ) WHERE rn >= #{startRow} AND rn <= #{endRow}
